caption:
Custom instructions for ChatGPT. System prompts for Claude. Gem instructions for Gemini.

You've probably set these up. You probably wrote something like "be concise" or "I'm a marketing professional" and called it a day.

And then wondered why the AI still doesn't *get* you.

Here's the real problem: those platforms give you a blank text box and zero guidance. So most people write the equivalent of a resume bullet point and expect the AI to read their mind.

What actually changes how an AI responds to you:

→ How you process information (visual? systems-first? narrative?)
→ What you're optimizing for (speed? depth? creativity? accuracy?)
→ How much hand-holding you want vs. how much you want to drive
→ What your default reaction is when an AI is wrong

None of that fits in "be concise. I work in marketing."

BootFile builds the instruction profile that actually belongs in those boxes — based on your real thinking patterns, not a guessing game.

One profile. Drop it into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini — wherever you work.

The AI doesn't change. But suddenly it stops feeling like it's talking to a stranger.
